records.title: ASADI: Accelerating Sparse Attention Using Diagonal-based In-Situ Computing
records.reason: The paper has quantitative transformer-attention efficiency results, but they are specific to a custom in-situ accelerator and PIM baseline; deployment transfer and comparable LLM serving measurements are not established.

records.title: DreamOn: Diffusion Language Models For Code Infilling Beyond Fixed-size Canvas
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01326. Primary abstract targets variable-length code infilling quality/flexibility in diffusion LMs; it does not report an inference-efficiency method or measurement.

records.title: Enforcing Temporal Constraints for LLM Agents
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23738. Primary abstract addresses temporal safety constraints for agents and constrained generation, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Principled RL for Diffusion LLMs Emerges from a Sequence-Level Perspective
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03759. Primary abstract develops sequence-level RL optimization for diffusion LMs during training; inference efficiency is not evaluated.

records.title: More than Carbon: Cradle-to-Grave environmental impacts of GenAI training on the Nvidia A100 GPU
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00093. Primary abstract assesses lifecycle environmental impacts of GenAI training, not inference/serving.
